speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand why you are waking up frightened during sleep, can you tell me exactly what happens during these episodes and how your child behaves when they wake up?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Nocturnal Panic Disorder (or Night Terrors/Psychogenic Sleep Disorder) - The patient's lack of confusion upon waking and ability to be consoled distinguishes this from classic night terrors, while the frequency and duration suggest an anxiety-based etiology rather than isolated REM sleep behavior disorder.
